title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff during regional failover and load shedding
author: Priya Shah
description: Urgent hotfix to prevent SLO enforcer thrashing during cross-region failover and aggressive load-shedding. Root cause: after a regional failover we observed duplicate backoff timers + immediate re-enqueueing of priority queue items which caused oscillation between backoff and resume states, resulting in sustained over-shedding and client-visible 429s. This change: (1) introduces a smoothing window for backoff hysteresis to avoid immediate re-tripping on transient spikes, (2) adds a single-flight guard to prevent duplicate backoff timers for the same enforcer shard after failover, (3) adds jitter to priority-queue drain scheduling to avoid synchronized drains across replicas, (4) tightens the ordering in the failover path to ensure in-flight acknowledgements are processed before enforcer state transitions, (5) exposes a feature-flag (slo_enforcer.backoff_smoothing=true) default-on for hotfix canary but reversible. Also includes metrics (enforcer.backoff_retries, enforcer.smoothing_applied, enforcer.duplicate_timer_blocked) and an integration test harness that simulates regional leader handoff under sustained load. We validated with canary in us-west-2 for 48 hours and saw 78% reduction in 429 spikes and no regression in latency P95. Rollout: merged to main and deployed to Dedicated and Hosted canary pools, feature flag will be toggled cluster-by-cluster during the next 24h. Follow-ups: clean up legacy backoff code (ENG-2175), add long-term telemetry alerting for smoothing bypass rates (ENG-2142).

review_threads: Asha Patel: Can you walk through why the single-flight guard is sufficient instead of a distributed lease? Author reply: The guard is designed to prevent duplicate timers within the same enforcer shard immediately after failover; cross-shard coordination adds latency and complexity and won't help the observed duplicate-timer case.

Marcus Nguyen: I'm concerned jitter magnitude could increase P99 in low-load regions. Author reply: jitter is bounded to 10-50ms and only applied when simultaneous drains are detected; added unit test to assert P99 regression is <1ms under synthetic low-load.

Lina Gómez: Please confirm metrics are emitted with cardinality limits. Author reply: counters are aggregated by shard and region and we cap label cardinality to known enums; added observability review notes.
Asha Patel: Approve after CI passes and canary validates.
Release engineering: Confirmed no infra changes required for rollout and feature flag toggle plan looks good.
